data.name: Kamalika
data.gender_notes: Kamalika is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Kamala’ which means lotus. Kamalika is a name of Goddess Kamalatmika, an embodiment of love and compassion in Hindu mythology. It is believed that the Goddess appears in the form of a lotus flower and grants blessings of love and prosperity. The name Kamalika carries the meaning “Lotus, Goddess of Love” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Kamalika usually hope their child will grow to embody lotus, goddess of love and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes love, compassion, and the power of transformation.
data.etymology: Kamalika belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lotus, Goddess of Love.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Kamalika total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

historical_references.reference: Kamalika, a celebrated Hindu princess of the Gupta Empire (320-550 AD), is famously mentioned in the 5th-century work 'Kumarasambhava' by the poet Kalidasa.
